source_admission: Primary issuer filings, monetary institutions, official guidance and existing project records. Targeted reading by the research team; external documents remain external. No future lunar law, institution, currency, rate or audience is inferred from present analogies.

sources.title: Liberty Media: Fourth Quarter and Year End 2025 Financial and Operating Results
sources.reading_scope: Formula 1 revenue composition and operating-cost discussion read; no valuation of teams, entire sports sector or transfer of margins to lunar operations.
sources.use: Media rights and sponsorship can be major separate sports revenue streams; reported shares are a business-model analogy, not a lunar audience forecast.

sources.title: Liberty Media Corporation 2025 Form 10-K
sources.reading_scope: Targeted advance-payment, deferred-revenue and commercial-contract passages read; no complete annual-filing audit.
sources.use: Upfront contract cash can precede earned revenue and leaves performance obligations; team and production costs remain.

sources.title: 14 CFR 460.51: Space flight participant training
sources.reading_scope: Current official section on emergency-response training read. Present US commercial-space rule only; no applicability to future lunar institutions asserted.
sources.use: Supports travel preparation as a distinct element from habitat competence and sport instruction; no specific lunar syllabus or safe participation criterion.

sources.title: World Bank PPP Resource Center: Key Issues in Developing Project Financed Transactions
sources.reading_scope: Revenue-certainty and financial-ratio/coverage passages read. No complete project-finance handbook or underwriting standard adopted.
sources.use: Coverage uses operating cash before equity distributions and compares with interest plus principal; downside and reserves require separate treatment. Lunar rates, terms and coverage thresholds are assumptions.

sources.title: SEC Investor.gov: Municipal Bonds
sources.reading_scope: Revenue versus general-obligation descriptions and risk passages read; no US tax exemption, jurisdiction or securities treatment transferred to the Moon.
sources.use: Different issuers and repayment sources distinguish project-revenue debt from broad public obligations.

sources.title: McLeay, Radia and Thomas: Money creation in the modern economy
sources.reading_scope: Overview and targeted loan-created-deposit, settlement/funding-limit passages on printed pages 14-17 read; no full literature review.
sources.use: Loan-created deposits remain distinct from the settlement assets needed for payments and from real resources or net wealth.

sources.title: Garratt and Shin: Stablecoins versus tokenised deposits: implications for the singleness of money, BIS Bulletin 73
sources.reading_scope: Key takeaways and issuer-claim/par-settlement discussion, printed pages 1-2 and targeted page 6 material read. No token architecture adopted.
sources.use: Local payment branding, redemption liabilities and settlement assets have distinct roles; a currency label does not supply development revenue.

sources.title: Hardy: Foreign currency borrowing, balance sheet shocks and real outcomes, BIS Working Paper 758
sources.reading_scope: Primary abstract and research summary/findings read; full paper and underlying firm data unexamined.
sources.use: Foreign-currency mismatch can affect firms; the signed toy currency calculation is independent arithmetic, not a forecast of lunar exchange rates.
